mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (sender_id, receiver_id, content, msg_type, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{msgType}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, u.name as sender_name, u.avatar as sender_avatar FROM chat_message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.sender_id = u.id WHERE (m.sender_id = #{userId1} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId2}) OR (m.sender_id = #{userId2} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId1}) ORDER BY m.create_time ASC
SELECT m.*, '系统通知' as sender_name, '/static/logo.png' as sender_avatar FROM chat_message m WHERE m.sender_id = 0 AND m.receiver_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.create_time DESC

SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN m.sender_id = 0 THEN '系统通知' ELSE u.name END as sender_name, CASE WHEN m.sender_id = 0 THEN '/static/logo.png' ELSE u.avatar END as sender_avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message cm WHERE cm.sender_id = contact_id AND cm.receiver_id = #{userId} AND cm.is_read = 0) as unread_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END as contact_id, MAX(create_time) as max_time FROM chat_message WHERE sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId} GROUP BY contact_id ) t JOIN chat_message m ON ( (m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.receiver_id = t.contact_id) OR (m.sender_id = t.contact_id AND m.receiver_id = #{userId}) ) AND m.create_time = t.max_time LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = t.contact_id ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
